Chapter ch1  The same box  (line 7)
  Synopsis: One box, two screens.
  Scene opening  INT. FIRST SCREEN - DAY  (line 11, transition: default)
    Elements
        box           show    @tl .box "A box"
        cap           show    @bc .muted hidden "The caption"
        old           show    @mr .label "Old news"
        foot          show    @bl .muted "Footer"
    Effects
      r1  show cap   word("corner").end
      f1  focus box  word("box", 2).start
      s1  sound pop  word("box", 2).end +100ms
    Lines
      opening.l1  (speed 0.99)
        "This box sits in the corner. The caption says what it is."
      opening.l2
        "Look at the box."
  Scene second  INT. SECOND SCREEN - DAY  (line 33, transition: auto-animate from opening)
    Elements
      - old           exit    @mr .label "Old news"
      ~ box           update  cell tl→mc, class box→accent
      ~ cap           update  text "The caption"→"The new caption"
        foot          same    @bl .muted "Footer"
      + new           enter   @tr .title hidden "New arrival"
    Effects
      s1  sound whoosh  transition.start
      s2  sound ding    when(box.move.progress >= 50%)
      r1  show new      word("enters").end
      f1  focus new     r1.end +3f
    Lines
      second.l1  (pause 0.5 s)
        "Same id, new place. A new element enters."
